_generated_by: manual (loop topology -- geometric free params + generator-derived electrical params)

width_um.description: Outer footprint width (x extent) of the rectangular loop

height_um.description: Outer footprint height (y extent) of the rectangular loop

track_width_um.description: Metal5 trace width -- keep well under min(width_um, height_um)/2 or the loop's inner opening closes

l.description: Series inductance of each half-winding -- fitted from a real openEMS Y11 run when available, otherwise a generic placeholder literal. See inductor_loop_generator.py's fit_electrical_params().

rs.description: Series winding resistance of each half-winding -- same fit/placeholder split as 'l'.

cox.description: Oxide/substrate coupling capacitance at each terminal -- real geometry x GF180MCU Metal5 areacap data, always computed for real (no FDTD needed).

rsub.description: Substrate loss resistance completing each terminal's oxide-coupling path -- PLACEHOLDER quality, not yet derived from any EM run (see gf180mcu_stack.json's substrate.resistivity_ohm_cm note).

csub.description: Substrate capacitance in parallel with rsub at each terminal -- PLACEHOLDER quality, same caveat as rsub.

cs.description: Coupling capacitance from each terminal to the center tap (ct) -- PLACEHOLDER quality; this generator's one-port EM methodology has no distinct 'ct' measurement yet.
